parameters.query:
SELECT c.id::text AS conversation_id,c.followup_count,c.last_customer_at,c.next_followup_at,cu.external_user_id AS sender_id,cu.id::text AS customer_id,
 ba.id::text AS account_id,ba.business_id,ba.platform,ba.external_account_id,ba.access_token,ba.reply_url,ba.followup_1_minutes,ba.followup_2_minutes,b.business_name
FROM conversations c JOIN customers cu ON cu.id=c.customer_id JOIN business_accounts ba ON ba.id=cu.account_id JOIN businesses b ON b.business_id=ba.business_id
WHERE c.human_mode=FALSE AND c.followup_enabled=TRUE AND c.next_followup_at IS NOT NULL AND c.next_followup_at<=NOW() AND c.followup_count<2 AND ba.active=TRUE AND b.active=TRUE
ORDER BY c.next_followup_at ASC LIMIT 100;

WITH ins AS (INSERT INTO followup_log(conversation_id,followup_no,message) VALUES($1::bigint,$2::int,$3) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING 1),upd AS (UPDATE conversations SET followup_count=$2::int,next_followup_at=CASE WHEN $2::int=1 THEN NOW()+INTERVAL '23 hours' ELSE NULL END,followup_enabled=CASE WHEN $2::int>=2 THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END,updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$1::bigint AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ins) RETURNING 1)
SELECT $4::text AS platform,$5::text AS sender_id,$6::text AS access_token,$7::text AS reply_url,$3::text AS reply,$8::text AS external_account_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM upd);
INSERT INTO bot_outbound_messages(platform,external_account_id,customer_external_id,message_id) SELECT $1,$2,$3,$4 WHERE COALESCE($4,'')<>'' ON CONFLICT(message_id) DO NOTHING;
